A little about me

About

A practical accounting and finance background, supported by postgraduate study and ongoing professional development.

I am an Accounting and Finance professional with experience in financial reporting, taxation, accounts management, budgeting and financial analysis.

Currently working as a Tax Advisor at PA Ltd, I support individual and business clients with tax return preparation, financial record analysis, tax planning and regulatory compliance. My experience also includes financial reporting, payroll processing, accounts payable and receivable, and budget monitoring.

In my Accountant role, I prepared and monitored annual budgets and contributed to an actual £3,000 reduction in operating expenses through cost-reduction initiatives.

I hold an MSc in Professional Accounting from Coventry University London (Merit), alongside a BCom in Computer Applications. I have cleared CA Intermediate and passed CMA Intermediate with Merit, as well as CMA Final Group IV. I am currently completing the remaining papers towards my ACCA qualification.
